name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for tinkering with anything mechanical. Growing up in a small town near Lisbon, he spent countless hours in his grandfather's workshop, learning the intricacies of engines and machinery. This hands-on experience led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he excelled in materials science and fabrication techniques.

After graduating, Ricardo joined a local racing team as a junior fabricator, quickly proving his worth through his meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving abilities. His dedication and passion for the sport eventually caught the attention of JOTA Sport, where he now plays a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and performance of their racing vehicles. Ricardo's approach is rooted in precision and a deep understanding of material properties, making him an invaluable asset to the team.

What distinguishes Ricardo is his unwavering commitment to perfection. He's not satisfied until every weld is flawless, every component is precisely aligned, and every detail meets his exacting standards. This relentless pursuit of excellence, coupled with his practical experience, makes him a rising star in the world of motorsport fabrication.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build with a focused gaze.
